Teatcher Svein:
Attribute bonuses affect both your combat and defensive stats.
[Attribute Types] Each Spirit is connected to one of the four main elements that birthed it: water, fire, wind, or earth.
[Attribute Attack] When fighting monsters, your damage is increased in accordance with your Attribute Attack. If the monster you target has an attribute, it can affect your damage output. The opposing attributes' effectappears when one of the two clashing attributes is strong, and the other one- weak. When you use an attribute against its opposite, you deal max 130% of damage. If the monster has no attribute and you have, you deal 10% of bonus damage. Attribute attack bonus is added automatically. The opposing attributes' correlation describes how attributes affect one another. Water is stronger than fire, fire is stronger than earth. Earth in return is stronger than wind, and wind is good against water. One attribute's power depends on other ones, so it's important to master them all.
[Attribute Resistance] If you are attacked by an attribute, your defense will be counted based on this attribute's P. Def. So having high Attribute Resistance is very useful.
